summary: Tested real payment status flow + SEO tab tweaks. Backend 14/15 pytest pass: notify status 0 keeps hold held+payment_pending; -1/-2/-3 -> payment_failed with cancelled/failed/chargedback; bad md5sig -> 400; failure never overrides confirmed; booking/status returns all new fields, 404 for unknown, expired held->expired, held+payment_pending not auto-expired by status endpoint; release: held->cancelled (released true), confirmed/payment_failed/held+pending/unknown untouched (released false). 1 FAIL: cleanup_expired_holds() DELETES expired payment_pending holds (and any held hold >5min) whenever availability/hold is called. Frontend all requested flows PASS: confirmed (verifying -> confirmed with ref/room/dates/LKR 9,450.00, one dataLayer purchase, none on revisit, none on failed); payment_failed reason + retry button -> details step with dates 2027-08-03..04 and guest name/email/phone/guests/special requests prefilled; cancelled -> 'Payment cancelled' and hold status becomes cancelled; never-confirming hold -> pending after 58.8s with exact message, hotel phone +94 112 301737, Check again restarts polling and shows confirmed after Mongo confirm; unknown order -> 'couldn't find this booking', no retry. CRM SEO: hint text removed; sitemap/robots buttons hidden when canonical empty and when only typed (unsaved); after save of https://www.kreationhotels.com/ hrefs are https://www.kreationhotels.com/sitemap.xml and /robots.txt, persist after reload; canonical restored to empty.

critical.issue: delete_many({status:'held', expires_at<now}) deletes payment_pending holds and any hold whose 5-min window passed while guest is still on PayHere. Then: /booking/status -> 404 so guest sees 'We couldn't find this booking' instead of the waiting message; and a later PayHere notify status_code 2 returns 'hold_not_found' -> money taken but NO booking created. Reproduced via test_pending_hold_survives_cleanup. Fix: exclude payment_pending:true from the delete (and ideally mark expired instead of deleting, and on notify 2 for an expired/missing-but-recorded hold still create the booking or flag for staff).

minor.issue: Only counts holds with expires_at>now, so a held+payment_pending hold past 5 min no longer blocks the room -> another guest can book the same room while PayHere is still processing (double-booking risk on late confirm).

action_items: HIGH: In cleanup_expired_holds exclude payment_pending holds (add 'payment_pending': {'$ne': True}); consider marking 'expired' instead of deleting so late PayHere notify (status 2) can still create the booking
MEDIUM: get_held_rooms_for_dates should keep blocking rooms for held+payment_pending holds even after expires_at
critical_code_review_comments: Polling continues if the guest closes the modal during 'verifying' (pollRef not cleared on close) - harmless but could fire trackPurchase/setState later; clear timeout in onClose
Retry reuses sessionStorage pending even after a cancelled/failed order from a different order id (no order_id match check against the returned order) - consider checking pending.order_id === order
Website.js 1064 lines and App.js ~15k lines - should be split
seed_data_creation: All test holds (guest_name 'Zz Test') deleted; no bookings/customers created (notify status 2 not called to avoid real SMS/email). SEO canonical_url restored to ''. Preview mode switched back to crm.
